subject: Confirm your email to activate your account
preheader: Confirm your address with the password you chose and your account is ready.
heading: Confirm your email address
body_html:
Hello {guest_first_name},

thank you for creating an account at {business_name}. Please confirm your email address to activate it – you will be asked for the password you chose when signing up:

{cta_button}

If the button does not work, open this link (valid for 48 hours): {verify_link}

Once confirmed, bookings made with this email address appear in your account and you receive a 5 % welcome coupon.

Did not create an account? Simply ignore this email – nothing will be set up, and without the password nobody can activate it.

Kind regards,
{business_name}
